body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. If you began in concealment, ignore 1 point of cover bonus.

surges.html: Move 1 unit toward cover after resolving.
Deal +1 Damage if the target was Exposed when you declared this Action.

rider.title: Contingency - Ambush
rider.html: When the target turns its attack toward another creature before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that attack.
